title: Nitrogen Generator
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.MISSION INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND.419TH CSB.W6QM MICC-FT DRUM
description_text: Nitrogen gas generator. Provides up to 35 LPM of nitrogen using room air, variable to 116 PSI. Produces 99.5% pure nitrogen. Uses a touchscreen user interface with integrated compressor. Comes with 1 year manufacturers warranty. Comes ready for AC 120V outlet and comes with 3-prong plug.
